basics.name: Emad Gohari
basics.headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer · LLM Agents, Evaluation, NLP

summary: Senior machine learning engineer with **8 years of experience** taking NLP and LLM systems from research to production. At Thomson Reuters Labs, built a **production LLM summarization workflow processing hundreds of reports daily**, combining targeted context extraction, source verification and citations, SME-driven evaluation, and **GPT-4/Claude Sonnet comparisons on quality, latency, and cost**. Contributed **agent configuration and reusable LLM-as-judge evaluation tooling** to **CLEAR Investigate**, a commercially launched agentic AI investigation product.

items: Model Training & Evaluation (F1 Score, ROC-AUC, MRR, MAP, Recall@k)

experience.description: Built LLM features, agent workflows, search models, and training pipelines at TR Labs for CLEAR, Thomson Reuters' due-diligence and investigation platform, and Checkpoint, its tax research platform. Worked with researchers, subject-matter experts, and product engineering.

projects.name: CLEAR Business AI: GenAI Report Summarization
projects.description: Built the LLM summarization workflow for CLEAR Business entity reports, **live in production processing hundreds of reports daily**.
highlights: **Context engineering:** designed selective XML extraction to feed each targeted LLM call only the relevant report fields and sections, covering business overview, key personnel, adverse media, liens, and lawsuits. Kept context focused to limit long-context degradation without truncating reports.

**Tool use and verification:** integrated Bing Search with an LLM verification step to **reduce false matches between same-named people and businesses**. Linked summary claims to their source locations in the report.

**Evaluation-driven iteration:** refined extraction logic and system prompts across SME annotation rounds, using product-manager exemplar summaries for 10-15 companies. Translated section-level feedback into extraction and prompt changes, including examples for facts embedded in free text.
**Quality, latency, and cost:** compared summary outputs from **GPT-4 and Claude Sonnet** on quality, latency, and cost to inform model selection.

projects.name: Agentic Investigation System: CLEAR Investigate
projects.description: Contributed to **CLEAR Investigate, Thomson Reuters' commercially launched agentic AI product** for investigations.
highlights: **Agent configuration:** built a central PydanticAI layer for system prompts, tool descriptions and availability, and agent/subagent wiring, enabling experimenters to **reconfigure investigation agents from one place** instead of editing scattered definitions.
**Evaluation tooling:** migrated the team's existing **LLM-as-judge evaluation** capability into an organized repository for reuse and future CI/CD integration.

projects.name: Semantic Search Query Understanding: Checkpoint Tax Research
projects.description: Shipped a **sentence-embedding query-intent classifier** that distinguished broad conceptual queries from specific tax lookups and promoted higher-level documents for non-specialist users, **improving access to conceptual documents by 95%** within a **~100ms latency budget**. Identified the retrieval gap through SME and customer feedback.

projects.name: Model Retraining & Experimentation Pipelines: CLEAR Entity Resolution
projects.description: Designed and built an **on-demand model-retraining pipeline** on SageMaker Pipelines, turning researchers' feature-generation, training, and evaluation code into reusable DAG steps. Enabled **parallel experiments tracked in MLflow**, cutting experiment turnaround by an **estimated ~40%**. Also built proof-of-concept Snowflake processing and training pipelines.

projects.name: Entity Resolution Data Infrastructure: CLEAR KYC/AML
projects.description: Built research data infrastructure for an entity-resolution system spanning **~800M entities**. Designed a **PII-isolated AWS research environment** using SageMaker Studio and CloudFormation; defined a **versioned schema reconciling two incompatible annotation sources**, with Spark pipelines to merge records and surface conflicts; and replaced manual runs with **scheduled, repeatable SageMaker Pipelines**.

experience.description: Built NLP and language-understanding systems end to end, from data preparation and model training to evaluation and application integration, including transformer fine-tuning and research collaborations with university and industry partners.

projects.name: Automated Question Generation: Fine-Tuned T5
projects.description: Fine-tuned the open-weights **T5** model to generate questions from documents, **cutting manual data-curation effort by 40%**. Experimented with input representations and evaluated generated text with BLEURT in a research collaboration with university partners.

projects.name: Conversational Question Answering with NLP & LSTM Models
projects.description: Developed a **conversational question-answering system** combining syntactic and semantic document analysis with **LSTM-based text tagging**. Used **semi-automatically generated ontologies** to interpret user questions and identify intent, and experimented with knowledge graphs for knowledge representation in an industry research collaboration.

projects.name: Domain-Specific Language Understanding
projects.description: Trained domain-specific **Word2Vec embeddings** and **LSTM-based NLU models**, with interpretability testing to make model decisions transparent.
